title: Quantifying Nonstabilizerness of Codeword-Stabilized Codes
summary: Universal quantum computation requires non-Clifford gates, which stabilizer codes can provide transversally only up to a finite level of the Clifford hierarchy. Non-stabilizer codes are not subject to this bound and are the natural candidates to fill the gap. However, it is difficult to efficiently evaluate the nonstabilizerness (or magic) of non-stabilizer codes. Here, we resolve this problem for codeword-stabilized (CWS) codes by showing that the nonstabilizerness of a CWS code is determined by the difference structure of its codewords.
